correctness.rationale: The one-zero kernel formula is derived by the standard weighted-kernel decomposition and a difference-of-squares factorization. For \(0<r<1\), the exact numerator/denominator comparison gives a strictly positive lower bound on the closed disk, so \(P_r\) cannot vanish on the closed bidisk. The torus minimization reduces to \(G_r(c)\), and its concavity/convexity cases prove \(\min |P_r|=(1-r)^2\). The triangle inequality gives zero-freeness under any perturbation with sup norm strictly below this value, and the constant perturbation at the threshold proves sharpness. The endpoint \(r=0\) is direct.
